title: Implement ARTICLE, HEAD, BODY with message-ID and number forms
description:
Implement ARTICLE [msgid|number]: return 220 followed by full article (header + blank line + body). Implement HEAD: return 221 header only. Implement BODY: return 222 body only. Both message-ID and article-number forms required. Dot-stuffing in article bodies. Artifact: reader/src/session/commands/fetch.rs.

Acceptance:
- ARTICLE <msgid> works in any group (message-ID is global)
- ARTICLE 42 works when a group is selected
- Dot-stuffing: lines starting with '.' have an extra '.' prepended
- ARTICLE on missing message-ID returns 430
- ARTICLE on missing article number returns 423
- Retrieved article body is byte-for-byte identical to what was POSTed
